page_title: MON 3-0 REI | Monaco v Reims 28/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Sergio Akieme (Reims) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
90' The resulting corner from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is cleared by the defence.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lamine Camara (Monaco) for Al Musrati.
86' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Yehvann Diouf saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.

85' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
84' It will be a corner kick for Monaco.
84' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

83' Radoslaw Majecki makes a brilliant save! Oumar Diakite (Reims) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
82' A pass by Lucas Michal (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
79' Mika Biereth (Monaco) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Lucas Michal replaces him.
76' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
75' Keito Nakamura (Reims) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
74' Substitution. George Ilenikhena (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Breel Embolo walks off.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Takumi Minamino can be given a rest.
74' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Vanderson and he is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
73' That will be all from Junya Ito who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
72' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Radoslaw Majecki is equal to it and makes an easy save.
71' A precise low pass is received by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
70' Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
70' Breel Embolo (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Monaco force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
69' The free kick is delivered by Teddy Teuma (Reims) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
68' Breel Embolo (Monaco) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
67' The resulting corner from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
67' Caio Henrique (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' Radoslaw Majecki makes a brilliant save! Keito Nakamura (Reims) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
64' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Vanderson (Monaco) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
61' Keito Nakamura (Reims) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
59' Teddy Teuma (Reims) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

58' Sergio Akieme (Reims) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Radoslaw Majecki thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
56' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Mika Biereth (Monaco) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
51' Breel Embolo (Monaco) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
46' Samba Diawara has made a change at the break. Oumar Diakite has come on in place of Malcolm Jeng (Reims).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Mika Biereth (Monaco) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Breel Embolo. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.

39' 2 - 0 Goal! Maghnes Akliouche displays great vision and sends a pass to Mika Biereth (Monaco), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 2:0.

38' Breel Embolo (Monaco) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
37' The resulting corner from Caio Henrique (Monaco) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

34' 1 - 0 Caio Henrique sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Mika Biereth (Monaco) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
32' Golden opportunity! Mika Biereth (Monaco) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
31' Half-chance! Mika Biereth (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf reacts well to snuff out the attack.
29' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
27' The ball rebounds out to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
27' Yehvann Diouf makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Breel Embolo (Monaco) after a cross from the side.
24' Al Musrati (Monaco) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
23' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
22' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Reims will have a corner.
20' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is easily saved by Yehvann Diouf.
19' Mika Biereth (Monaco) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.

18' Sergio Akieme (Reims) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Monaco.
16' Al Musrati (Monaco) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
16' The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
16' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Al Musrati (Monaco), but it's just wide of the left post.
16' The ball is out of play and Monaco manage to earn a corner.
15' The corner from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is hurriedly cleared.
14' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
12' Half-chance! Vanderson (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf reacts well to snuff out the attack.
11' Keito Nakamura (Reims) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

10' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
8' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
7' Joseph Okumu (Reims) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. Monaco are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
3' Junya Ito (Reims) produces a poor cross from the free kick which is easily turned away.
2' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. Reims earn a free kick.

1' Mika Biereth (Monaco) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
